provenance.negative_section_y: External reader adapter interprets official section Y byte >127 as signed (subtract 256). Same correction before and after; no edits to shared measurement tools.
provenance.discarded: Initial A2-only binary lacked R1 fixes; all its samples are excluded. Before was rebuilt from exact git archive HEAD 9910307. Final-pre-camp-fix is also excluded. Final worlds are entirely freshly generated by final verified binary.

intermediate_selection_fixed.note: RNG and pivots fixed; truncated template frames not yet corrected in this intermediate sample.

terrain_reference.method: Fresh same-seed official worlds with generate-structures=false, max heap 2G, port 26185, two active processors. Ground observations outside camp frames differ from ordinary generation; ship rings serve as unchanged controls. Padding was corrected before adding terrain adaptation.

remaining_unverified: Stronghold relocation: 70/128 and 78/128 exact; raw ring geometry consistent for all 256 does not prove biome relocation. Sixth measured mask remains unreproduced.
One missing village in each main square; one second-seed monument and pyramid missing. Camp start sets now exact, but one flower_forest/meadow variant differs.
Second-seed mineshafts 132 vs 131, only 129 coincident; deep-dark exclusion height unverified.

Ship wood-palette random stream and placement height; portal vertical height and material processing; ocean-ruin decay palette and floor adaptation; camp vertical adaptation and post-campsite tree randomness. Template/pivot/cluster selection corrections do not prove composition within tolerance.
Biome-conditional strata are small and include terrain. Unpaired strata are not successful comparisons. All pooled air/water failures, including regressions, are retained.
Igloo, swamp hut and mansion have zero starts in both main squares; positive earlier placement-grid fixtures still cover their grids. No density success inferred from zeros.

ship_wood_observations.method: Read only naturally generated saved blocks at transformed wood cells of our own measured templates. Votes compare wood name only for matching block-kind suffix; no archive, template dump or game code. Only 102 of 107 metadata fixtures supplied both wood groups from saved chunks. Remaining 5 were not counted as failures or successes.
